daily.title: Brought-Forward Loans Cannot Be Added U/s 68 Even in Search Assessments: ITAT Delhi
daily.summary: Delhi ITAT deletes ₹63 lakh addition on brought-forward loans, remands fresh loans for verification and upholds ₹55 lakh unexplained money addition. The Delhi Bench of the Income Tax Appellate Tribunal held that unsecured loan balances brought forward from an earlier year cannot be added under Section 68 as credits of the year under assessment . The Assessing Officer had added the entire closing balance of ₹1,24,50,000 under Section 69A . On comparing the lender-wise balances, the Tribunal found that ₹63 lakh represented amounts carried forward from the preceding year and deleted the addition to that extent.

daily.title: TDS U/s 194J Alone Cannot Trigger Section 44ADA Without Specified Profession: ITAT Rajkot
daily.summary: Rajkot ITAT deletes ₹14.63 lakh addition, holding that Section 194J TDS alone cannot justify applying Section 44ADA to e-commerce marketing receipts. The Rajkot Bench of the Income Tax Appellate Tribunal held that the payer’s deduction of TDS under Section 194J does not, by itself, establish that the recipient carries on a profession covered by Section 44AA(1) of the Income-tax Act, 1961. The Assessing Officer had applied the 50% presumptive rate under Section 44ADA to part of the receipts from an e-commerce marketing business based on the payer’s TDS classification.

daily.title: ITAT Delhi: Two Floors of Same Building Qualify as One House Under Section 54
daily.summary: ITAT Delhi allows Section 54 exemption for two floors of the same building and excludes Section 143(1)(a) adjustment made after scrutiny commenced. The Delhi Bench of the Income Tax Appellate Tribunal held that the first and second floors of the same building , purchased on the same date under separate sale deeds, could together constitute one residential house for exemption under Section 54 of the Income-tax Act, 1961 . The Tribunal directed the Assessing Officer to allow the claim for both floors, reversing the disallowance of ₹3,20,08,245 .

daily.title: Senior Citizen Tax Rates For Tax Year 2026-27: With Example on Different Income Levels
